description: Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal with live syncing and per-base digit validation.

faqs.a: Each base only accepts its own digits: binary 0–1, octal 0–7, decimal 0–9, hexadecimal 0–9/A–F. Anything else is rejected with an error.
faqs.q: Why do I get an error when I type?

faqs.a: Yes. Conversion uses BigInt, so there is no 32-bit or floating-point limit — numbers with hundreds of digits convert exactly.
faqs.q: Does it handle very large numbers?

faqs.a: No. This tool supports non-negative integers only.
faqs.q: Can I convert negative or fractional numbers?

howto: Type a number into any one of the four base fields.
The other three bases update instantly as you type.
Invalid digits for the chosen base show an error instead of converting.
See the bit length, decimal digit count and byte size below.
